acceptance.canonicalization_algorithm: JCS_LIKE_V1: recursively normalize JSON object keys and string values to Unicode NFC; reject normalized-key collisions before serialization; UTF-8; objects sorted lexicographically by normalized key; arrays preserve order; version fields require JSON integer type exactly; separators comma/colon; no insignificant whitespace; LF only
acceptance.duplicate_gate: Derive the semantic-core idempotency key before any write. A second candidate with the same key is classified DUPLICATE and produces no second event, no CURRENT update, and no Slack post. Best-effort repository search must show no existing proposed key before the first write.
acceptance.idempotency_formula: sha256(object_id|expected_version|next_version|campaign_id|wake_ordinal|prior_digest|current_blob|task_id|transition_kind|controlled_probe_name); nonce, valid_time, transaction_time, verifier runtime metadata, and Slack metadata are excluded
acceptance.next_wake_requirement: If accepted, run X12_IDEMPOTENCY_STRATEGY_C9 wake 2/4 from CURRENT v33. Vary only the idempotency strategy probe, reject duplicate idempotency keys and stale expected versions, and do not claim database or cross-system transaction guarantees.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Event-first. After immutable event commit and exact readback, fetch CURRENT a second time and require exact version 32, projection digest 231a28f91352c93f1c57092ca51b55c242b9f2843b5b31dd036fc9b1ca06fc70, and blob 73ee5aa3eb1a62ac0dd2d30e7db338af75e5e4de. Replace CURRENT only using that exact blob SHA. Then read back CURRENT, the v33 event, and the v32 predecessor event and require exact latest-event, predecessor-event, prior-digest, prior-CURRENT, campaign-progress, and idempotency-measurement bindings.
acceptance.slack_post_rule: Post one sanitized pointer only after CURRENT advances to v33. A duplicate or unchanged transition produces no Slack post.
acceptance.stale_version_gate: Any expected-version or prior-blob mismatch must fail the single-file CURRENT replacement and must not be retried as an unconditional overwrite.

experiment.baseline: CURRENT v32 at blob 73ee5aa3eb1a62ac0dd2d30e7db338af75e5e4de; C9 idempotency_strategy 0/4; prior event digest 26fd43172c0ae6cc7c48971babb7a2c08197ff31d7cf4b1334ae628d981c6743.
experiment.controlled_factor: Idempotency-key composition only. Compare two candidate envelopes with different nonce and valid/transaction times but the same semantic transition tuple. Retain event-first ordering, exact second CURRENT read, compact dual anchors, exact prior blob-SHA replacement, and sequential post-update triangulation.
experiment.exact_probe: Construct envelope A and envelope B for the same v32-to-v33 semantic transition. Vary only nonce and valid/transaction times. Derive the key from the semantic core, verify both envelopes yield 5a3c8119e63d9be67ac9b32310512b5548017e75ec7283ce4858b5cb5591daf2, classify envelope B as a duplicate before writes, require zero repository matches for the proposed key, and accept at most envelope A through the retained pointer gates.
experiment.honest_flaw: This is a bounded local deterministic envelope-variance specimen, not a concurrent replay against a server-side uniqueness constraint. GitHub code search is best-effort, non-atomic, and can lag. A malicious or buggy producer can alter semantic fields included in the key and evade deduplication; excluding envelope fields can also collapse two transitions that were intended to be distinct if the semantic tuple is underspecified. The immutable event and CURRENT are separate commits and Slack follows both, so a crash can leave an orphan event or missing Slack pointer. GitHub's per-file blob-SHA guard does not provide cross-file atomicity, locks, linearizability, serializable isolation, database durability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, or automatic repair.
experiment.hypothesis: A key derived only from the declared semantic transition core remains stable when transport-envelope nonce and timestamps vary, allowing a duplicate candidate to be rejected before writes without making exactly-once claims.
experiment.rollback: Never delete the immutable event or Slack message. If the semantic-core idempotency projection is later rejected, append a compensating event from the then-current version and replace CURRENT only using that pointer file's exact then-current blob SHA; preserve the duplicate specimen and reconstruct history from immutable events and referenced prior CURRENT blobs.

experiment.strongest_falsifier: Changing only nonce or valid/transaction times changes the key; the same key advances state twice; the proposed key already existed but the search missed it; an expected-version or prior-blob mismatch still advances CURRENT; event bytes fail digest recomputation; or final CURRENT/event/predecessor bindings disagree.
